role: Runs after slide descriptions are generated and before image generation; blocks prompts that do not explicitly carry face structure, expression, clothing, and cross-slide identity continuity.

slides.identity_notes: Use selected identity bundle as actual visual reference; faces are often distant or partial, so preserve hair silhouette, skin tone, body proportions, wardrobe anchors, and relationship energy.

must_preserve.face_structure: Preserve Aachu/Zuv identity from the selected bundle even when faces are tiny, profile, back-view, or partly hidden: Aachu long dark wavy hair, expressive brows/eyes, petite softer presence; Zuv curly dark hair, strong brows, stubble, broader/taller calm presence.
must_preserve.facial_expression: Match the slide emotion (quiet pre-love almostness, cinematic but safe) without inventing generic faces; use recognizable hair silhouette, posture, and wardrobe when faces are distant.
must_preserve.clothing: Keep continuity cues: Aachu light top, denim, red patterned scarf or red bag, small jewelry; Zuv navy/black layer, tan trousers, watch, casual shoes.
must_preserve.cross_slide_consistency: The pair must read as the same recurring South Asian couple in every slide through face cues, hair, body proportions, wardrobe, and relationship energy.
